headings.usage: Use for all Wizard step titles, dashboard headers, and major sections.

body.usage: Use for data tables, form inputs, and general body text for maximum clarity and tabular numeral support.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headings (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase, text-xs, with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Tabular data MUST use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for vertical alignment of numbers.
Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Use #002FA7 (International Klein Blue) exclusively for primary CTAs and active state indicators.
Never use pure black or grey. Tint greys slightly cool (blue undertone).
Hover state color must be a lighter/darker hue of the active state color, explicitly defined.
Do NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

visual_enhancers.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a subtle shadow (shadow-md) and border color darkens.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius). Use border-collapse for grid layouts.
visual_enhancers.effects: Use 1px inner borders to separate surfaces. Avoid muddy gray transparency; no full-screen gradients.

grids_and_layouts.gaps: Tight spacing (gap-4 or gap-6) for data correlation.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Right-align all numeric data in tables. Left-align text. Center-align only if it improves visual balance.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

tables.style: Efficient, compact design. Sticky headers, hoverable rows (bg-muted/50), right-aligned numeric columns.
tables.features: Pagination controls, sticky first column for critical data (e.g., Channel/Program), alternating row colors or subtle bottom borders.

wizard.style: Horizontal progress indicator showing steps (Upload -> Configure -> Schedule -> View).
wizard.interactions: Smooth transitions between steps. Clear 'Next' and 'Back' buttons.

forms.style: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Stacked labels with clear contrast.
forms.customization: No native inputs. Use crisp borders, clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).

charts.usage: Bar charts for weekly GRP dispersion, Pie/Donut charts for Edit-wise split.

rules: Minimalist animations. Use micro-interactions for feedback.
Hover states for all interactive elements (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
Staggered entrance animations for table rows or dashboard widgets.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-plan-button').

media_and_images.strategy: Minimal images. Focus on typography and data clarity.

image_urls.description: Abstract data dashboard view, used as a subtle background or illustration for the 'Upload Plan' empty state.

3d_libraries.decision: Not required for this B2B data-heavy tool.
3d_libraries.alternative: Use lightweight 2D data visualization (recharts) for maximum performance and clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Manrope and IBM Plex Sans.
Initialize Shadcn UI and add components: table, form, input, select, button, card, progress, dialog.
Build a multi-step layout with a fixed sidebar or top wizard progress bar.
Implement the Drag-and-Drop file upload zone using a dashed border and clear CTA.
Build the interactive 'Edit Dispersion' form allowing dynamic rows of percentages that must sum to 100%.
Ensure the complex data table for the 'schedule' output has a horizontal scroll, sticky headers, and right-aligned metrics.
Use Recharts to show 'Weekly GRP Dispersion' and 'Edit-wise Split'.
Apply the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' theme: white surfaces, strict borders, pure primary blue for active elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, even in 2D dashboards.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or max 8px radius) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Static = dead.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Ensure all interactive elements have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
